summary: QNB Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing the completion of its previously announced acquisition of The Victory Bancorp, Inc. The merger occurred on April 1, 2026, with QNB surviving. The filing includes Victory's unaudited financial statements and pro forma combined financials. No deal terms (price, premium, advisor) are stated. The transaction was announced September 23, 2025, and closed in April 2026. As a post-closing compliance filing, the risk-arb angle is moot; the focus is on integration and financial reporting.
